name: Gateway & Entry Points
description: TCP/TLS gateway with authenticated client sessions and the line-based wire protocol, plus the Main launcher (server, add-user, compact, quarantine modes) and the interactive CLI client.

name: Exchange Core
description: Single-writer ExchangeService queue and Exchange.process pipeline that stamps, journals, feeds the Ledger and notifies listeners, plus replay, snapshots, output digest and poison-pill recovery.

name: Commands & Journal
description: Sequencer-stamped command records (NEW, CANCEL, CANCEL_ALL, SKIP, CHECK) and the checksummed, fsynced, file-locked write-ahead CommandJournal with its v3 text codec.

name: Matching Engine
description: Deterministic price-time MatchingEngine and its output records (responses, executions, trades, cancel results, book snapshots, reject reasons).

name: Order Book
description: Limit order book with price levels and order nodes whose package-private mutators enforce the book invariants, exposing fills, level updates and read-only resting-order views.

name: Domain Model
description: Foundational order types, sides, validated OrderRequest and the versioned Rules that every replayed behaviour depends on.

name: Tests & Benchmarks
description: JUnit test classes mirroring each main package with @Nested behaviour groups, the MutableClock test seam, and JMH matching and batching benchmarks.

name: Documentation & Study Guides
description: Vision and Spec design documents (roadmap, numbered decisions D1-D77), README and CLAUDE.md, and the understanding/ study guides with the generator that assembles FULL-CONTEXT.md.

name: Build & Tooling
description: Maven pom with test, mutation (PIT) and bench (JMH) profiles, the Maven wrapper scripts and properties, and git attributes that keep the journal LF-only.
